title: Describing what one has never seen
literal_meaning: Without seeing the ou fruit, declaring it has six sections.
explanation: The source mocks confident description without firsthand knowledge. The stated number belongs to the boast being questioned, not a botanical lesson.
meaning_odia: ନିଜେ ନ ଜାଣିଥିବା କଥାକୁ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ଭାବେ ବଖାଣିବାକୁ ଏହି କଥା ସମାଲୋଚନା କରେ।
usage_example: Someone confidently reviews a book they have never opened. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: No claim about the fruit’s actual structure.
